capabilities: Search the Zotero library by meaning with locally embedded titles and abstracts
Create literature notes from Zotero metadata with frontmatter, citation and abstract
Write page-cited reading notes (Claim, Method, Data, Results, Limitations) from the PDF
Answer one question about a paper with page citations under a Q&A section
Collect verbatim quotes with page numbers across multiple papers into one note
disambiguation: Not a Zotero import or citation-picking tool like Zotero Integration; its job is semantic search and model-written, page-cited reading notes.
extras: Part of the author's Companion suite of local-first plugins; warns that model-copied quotes must be checked against the page before citing, and documents troubleshooting for Zotero's local API (port 23119, IPv4-only localhost).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search a Zotero library semantically or produce reading notes and answers that cite PDF page numbers.

relations.evidence: Paper Companion does not replace it; it adds the parts that need a local model
Ollama with a chat model and an embedding model

requires.name: Zotero 7+ (local API) or a CSL JSON / Better BibTeX JSON export
Ollama with a chat model and an embedding model
Better BibTeX (optional, for citation keys and auto-export)
Zotero Integration (optional, for citation picking and template import)

summary: Research companion that searches a Zotero library by meaning and generates page-cited reading notes and answers from PDFs using a local Ollama model.
